page.notes: Word-level doubts: "abditissimarum" (printed form "abdiciffimarum" or similar, reading uncertain), "futurus" (printed "futurjs", reading uncertain), "ité" (uncertain), "qui& intuentur" (spacing as printed). Long s has been rendered as plain s throughout. The small dashes at the left margin beside lines 6 to 22 are not text and were not transcribed. The text ends with "& in", which is the last printed line and continues onto the next page. No catchword or signature is printed.
